reason: The plugin adds DSH interface controls that request the host system to open the current Workspace root directory, making file and desktop integration its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加按钮和菜单项，用于在运行 DSH 的主机上打开当前 Workspace 根目录。
summaries.en: Adds buttons and menu items to the DeepSeek Harness web interface for opening the current Workspace root directory on the host running DSH.

capabilities: Adds workspace menu and session-header controls to the DSH web interface
Requests the DSH host to open the current workspace root directory using a client connection RPC
Uses platform-specific system directory opening mechanisms, including WSL path conversion
